objective: Test whether the System-IFEval active-treatment result transfers beyond Qwen without running task-incompatible model cells.

benchmark.name: System-IFEval
benchmark.reason: The task directly measures system-instruction compliance under compression and uses a public deterministic grader.

stages.run: Both candidate models on the first 30 frozen prompts.
stages.scale_if: At least 15/30 prompts are prompt-strict correct, with zero runtime errors.
stages.stop_if: The capability threshold is not met.

stages.run: StreamingLLM and its AuthorityKV composition at 40% KV for the eligible model with the higher FullKV capability count.
stages.scale_if: AuthorityKV improves prompt-strict accuracy by at least 0.20 on the FullKV-strict population, with at least five authority-only discordant pairs and no paired-budget mismatch.
stages.stop_if: The base has no meaningful compression headroom or the paired improvement threshold is not met.

stages.run: FullKV plus the registered paired treatment on all 150 prompts for the selected model.
stages.promote_if: Execution audit passes, the FullKV-strict population contains at least 60 prompts, the paired prompt-strict effect is positive with exact McNemar p < 0.05, and the instruction-strict paired-bootstrap interval excludes zero.
stages.stop_if: Any audit or confirmatory criterion fails; retain the result as a reported boundary outside the main claims.

selection_rule: Select the eligible model with the larger FullKV prompt-strict count; break an exact tie by the model order listed above. No compressed outcome is observed before selection.
reporting: Retain every FullKV capability result, including failed gates.
Do not pool models or replace the registered 30-prompt pilot after observing outputs.
Do not promote pilot-only effects as full-scale evidence.
Preserve exact run commands, model revisions, dataset/configuration hashes, predictions, scores, and execution audits.
